blog_title: Benchmark Beaters Weekly: 39 Stocks Beating Their Benchmarks (September 29, 2026)
email_subject: Benchmark Beaters: MATR & MRNA lead 39 stocks beating the market
preview_text: 19 Canadian and 20 U.S. names at six-month relative highs. Full table and charts inside.
intro: The latest Benchmark Beaters screen (as of September 29, 2026) found 39 Canadian and U.S. stocks outperforming their benchmarks, each hitting a new six-month relative high in the last five trading days.

In Canada, 19 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the TSX Composite, 10 of them new to the list this week. Mattr Corp. (MATR) leads with a +135% six-month return, and Industrials is the most represented sector with 6 names.

In the U.S., 20 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the S&P 500, 10 of them new to the list this week. Moderna Inc. (MRNA) leads with a +305% six-month return, and Health Care is the most represented sector with 9 names.
